purpose: Start at the recovered acquisition snapshot, preserve all available records and relationships, and define question-specific analysis views after measurement. Fix evaluation procedures, not expected findings or their explanations.

source.source_scope: recovered photo-metadata snapshot, not all iNaturalist records at present and not proof that all image bytes were downloaded
source.earlier_source_limit: The merged snapshot omits one original chunk link and 46 additional links recovered from archived API records; see reproducibility/v3_source_reconciliation_20260907.json. Its inventory remains a historical comparison, not the fully reconciled source-link ledger. The first chunk has no raw API archive and collection-time coverage is not fully recoverable.

preservation.raw_source: retain immutable metadata/API snapshots separately from versioned local ledgers; exact hashes and source row numbers preserve links
preservation.images: cache permissible exact bytes once per content hash, retain every observation-photo link and processing version; record unavailable, changed, failed and rights-restricted sources explicitly
preservation.privacy_and_rights: no de-obscuring coordinates; metadata retention is not permission to download or redistribute every image; raw identifiers, attribution and image files remain outside GitHub

units.record: a row in a versioned source snapshot; retain duplicates and conflicts as explicit records
units.photo: an image identity/content version with one or more observation links
units.head: a detection within a specific photo/model version; not automatically a biological individual
units.observation: the analysis sampling unit; may contain several photos and several heads
units.taxon: versioned source assignment plus resolved-name provenance; not independently verified image identification
units.replication: never count related photos or heads as independent observations; split development/evaluation by source observation and content-duplicate group
units.repeat_photo_limit: same observation ID alone does not establish the same individual or head; unmatched photos cannot identify pure photographic variance

stages.implementation: workflow.py inventory; reconcile_sources.py for original/API source-link recovery
stages.output: source-record and observation-photo link ledgers, observation aggregation, legacy-v2 overlap and explicit collection-coverage gaps

stages.implementation: recover_upstream.py, audit_processing_history.py and build_image_workspace.py; build_dependence_groups.py retains the full source universe and propagates known exact-image/observation links and historical development exposure
stages.output: archived raw-query and historical-processing coverage; photo/cache identity, versions, dependence components and usage provenance without claiming full-source image availability or fresh independent validation

stages.implementation: detect_cached_images.py; image_features.py and measure_cached_heads.py for resumable all-27 baseline extraction; recover_display_composition.py for five historically measured but unaggregated fields; perturb_cached_heads.py implements the saved 14-condition grid and summarize_perturbations.py its component-weighted changes and attrition; full-source image execution and completed technical-summary receipts remain pending
stages.output: all detections and negative/failed jobs; raw values, endpoint-specific eligibility, masks, paired context and explicit measurement/evaluation coverage

stages.implementation: prepare_observation_annotations.py implements separate full-source date, hemisphere, public-coordinate, precision and source-status preparation; complete preparation receipts and model-specific cohort builders/runners remain pending
stages.output: versioned source annotations without trait joins, followed by reversible observation-membership views with exact formulas, denominators and uncertainty
methodological and ecological results from shared saved tables; include missingness and failures

measurement_design.detector_role: locate visible capitula; detection negatives are not ecological absences
measurement_design.functions_role: extract declared continuous image features from explicit head/corolla/involucre masks
measurement_design.endpoint_scope: retain all 27 original endpoint slots. Correction: the five endpoints absent from the frozen v2 atlas were already computed at head level; the historical aggregator omitted visibility and four colour fractions. Their recovery is a new aggregation view, not retroactive v2 execution or a claim that five functions were unfinished. Preserve joint hue and closed colour composition; version any changed measurement or aggregation definition.
measurement_design.image_quality: endpoint-specific flags and uncertainty, not a universal image deletion rule; a photo can support colour but not outline or vice versa
measurement_design.automated_evaluation: source-observation-separated model provenance, bbox perturbation, resolution/sharpness and relevant photometric perturbations; preserve linked per-unit outcomes
measurement_design.colour_context: paired flower and non-flower context, with lightness/hue; background ecology and low power limit negative-control interpretation
measurement_design.stage_and_time: retain observed date, encode calendar harmonics with hemisphere interactions, and characterize automated stage-state uncertainty separately
measurement_design.evidence_ceiling: technical repeatability and image-feature comparability; automated consistency alone is not physical accuracy, pigment calibration or biological-stage ground truth
measurement_design.parameters: save code/model/input hashes and an endpoint-specific execution specification before each image pass; no selection by ecological significance

analysis_views.methodology: all rights-usable image records, including non-species assignments, non-native or unknown status, and unavailable coordinates where appropriate; report eligibility per endpoint
analysis_views.ecology: wild records with adequate identification and exposure support for the question; retain native, introduced and unresolved strata rather than imposing one destructive global filter
analysis_views.native_status: attach a versioned source-backed regional assignment before applicable models; unassessed outside the v2 subset stays unassessed, never guessed from absence
analysis_views.spatial_sampling: preserve unthinned observations in the master data; use appropriate spatial dependence/weighting in analysis and thinning only as an explicitly justified analysis view
analysis_views.aggregation: retain head/photo values and uncertainty; derive observation summaries or nested models without assigning extra independent weight to photo-rich observations
analysis_views.environment_alignment: trait and exposure summaries use the same eligible observation IDs for that endpoint/model; store geographic uncertainty and missing exposure separately
analysis_views.models: distinguish exploratory marginal atlas from conditional questions; include relevant timing/imaging and spatial terms in the saved primary specification, not a significance-driven sequence of repairs
analysis_views.collinearity: assess correlations, rank, condition number and VIF on the actual conditional-model cohort; no significance-driven covariate deletion or independent-effect claims from univariate fits
analysis_views.phylogeny: use the same model specification for applicable placement sensitivity; direct-tip coverage and lambda limit interpretation; placements are not independent replicates
analysis_views.remaining_sensitivities: retain only assumptions not already handled in the main design, such as dominant-taxon influence, range-scope comparison and measurement uncertainty; report magnitude changes, not sign alone
analysis_views.before_execution: save the exact estimand, cohort membership, formulas, weighting/nesting, resampling units/seeds and multiplicity grid after the full-source audit, before fitting v3 models
analysis_views.legacy_v2: 46276 thinned observations are a comparison view, never the new acquisition denominator; earlier 142-taxon and native 50-observation audit schedules are checkpoints, not full v3 measurement coverage

reporting.outcome_exposure: v2-selected follow-ups remain post-selection; no retrospective preregistration claim
reporting.unexpected_findings: report and interpret them; mark new explanations and follow-up analyses as post-inspection exploration
reporting.methodological_contribution: recoverable coverage, image-to-feature procedure, technical error, comparability and reproducibility
reporting.ecological_contribution: estimated image-feature associations and uncertainty within the stated sampling and exposure support
reporting.limits: no adaptation from association, no biological variance from image variance alone, no anthocyanin from chroma alone, no absolute accuracy from repeatability
reporting.public_repository: scientific code, protocols and aggregate outputs only; private manuscripts and individual replies stay local
